stories.title: Former Barnsley manager Thordarson dies aged 71
stories.summary: Gudjon Thordarson, who led Stoke City to promotion from the third tier in 2002 and managed three other English clubs, dies aged 71.

stories.title: Yorkshire volunteer groups receive King's Awards
stories.summary: Groups across Yorkshire receive the award, which is equivalent to an MBE, on the King's birthday.

stories.title: Opera transformed with a Yorkshire dialect
stories.summary: The Mozart opera has been translated into Yorkshire by Ian McMillan and Punjabi and Urdu too.

stories.title: 'I dropped out of university - but now I'm teaching at one'
stories.summary: Dr Rebecca Sharpe felt "lost" at university before dropping out - yet she now has a PhD.

stories.title: Yorkshire news quiz of the week - test your knowledge
stories.summary: How much Yorkshire news can you remember from the last seven days?

stories.title: 'No improvement' on landfill pong say neighbours
stories.summary: The Environment Agency is considering what actions it can take against the site in Doncaster.

stories.title: One dead and two hurt after cars hit horses on M18
stories.summary: The M18 was closed in both directions as a result of the collision for much of the day.

stories.title: Microsoft outage: Yorkshire councils and police hit
stories.summary: The issue has meant councils, police services and many NHS services have no access to emails.

stories.title: Rape arrest over Trans Pennine Trail sex attack
stories.summary: Officers say a 53-year-old man was arrested in Rotherham on Thursday.

stories.title: Yorkshire re-sign paceman Ali on T20 deal
stories.summary: Yorkshire re-sign Pakistan fast bowler Hassan Ali on a two-year T20 Blast contract for 2027 and 2028.

stories.title: England's first health commissioner is appointed
stories.summary: Former Barnsley Council leader Sir Steve Houghton takes on the new role, the first in the country.

stories.title: Hunt for rapists convicted of teenager's abuse
stories.summary: Police are searching for Mudasar Hussain and Kamir Khan, who were convicted in their absence.
